
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Tanisha Mani — Engineering Portfolio</title>
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&family=DM+Sans:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,300&display=swap');
  *,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
  :root{--black:#0a0a0a;--white:#f5f2eb;--red:#d42b2b;--steel:#8fa3b1;--mid:#1e1e1e;--border:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{background:var(--black);color:var(--white);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:300;overflow-x:hidden;}

  .site-nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(10,10,10,0.92);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:0 2rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:52px;}
  .site-nav-name{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:1.1rem;letter-spacing:0.08em;}
  .nav-links{display:flex;gap:2rem;}
  .nav-links a{font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.15em;color:var(--steel);text-decoration:none;text-transform:uppercase;transition:color 0.2s;}
  .nav-links a:hover{color:var(--red);}

  .hero{min-height:100vh;display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr auto;position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:2rem;padding-top:70px;}
  .hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 40% at 80% 50%,rgba(212,43,43,0.12) 0%,transparent 70%),radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 60% at 20% 80%,rgba(143,163,177,0.06) 0%,transparent 60%);pointer-events:none;}
  .hero-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding-bottom:1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);position:relative;z-index:10;}
  .hero-tag{font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:0.65rem;letter-spacing:0.25em;color:var(--red);text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.75rem;}
  .hero-tag::before{content:'';width:2rem;height:1px;background:var(--red);}
  .hero-center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:4rem 0;position:relative;z-index:10;}
  .hero-title{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(4rem,12vw,11rem);line-height:0.88;letter-spacing:0.01em;margin-bottom:2rem;}
  .accent{color:var(--red);}
  .hero-sub{font-size:1rem;color:var(--steel);max-width:520px;line-height:1.8;}
  .hero-bottom{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;position:relative;z-index:10;padding-top:1rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);}
  .hero-stats{display:flex;gap:3rem;}
  .stat-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.25rem;}
  .stat-num{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:2rem;line-height:1;}
  .stat-label{font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.15em;color:var(--steel);text-transform:uppercase;}
  .scroll-hint{font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.15em;color:var(--steel);text-transform:uppercase;animation:bounce 2s ease-in-out infinite;}
  @keyframes bounce{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);}50%{transform:translateY(4px);}}

  .proj-index{max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;padding:5rem 2rem;}
  .section-header{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:1.5rem;margin-bottom:3rem;padding-bottom:1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
  .section-num{font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:0.65rem;color:var(--red);}
  .section-title{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(2.5rem,5vw,4rem);letter-spacing:0.02em;}
  .project-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1px;background:var(--border);}
  .project-card{background:var(--black);padding:2.5rem 2rem;cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.2s;}
  .project-card:hover{background:var(--mid);}
  .project-card-num{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:3rem;color:rgba(212,43,43,0.2);line-height:1;margin-bottom:1rem;}
  .project-card-title{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:1.6rem;letter-spacing:0.03em;margin-bottom:0.75rem;}
  .project-card-desc{font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--steel);line-height:1.7;}
  .project-card-tag{font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:0.6rem;color:var(--red);letter-spacing:0.15em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:1.5rem;}

  .proj-section{max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;padding:5rem 2rem;}
  .proj-header{border-top:3px solid var(--red);padding-top:3rem;margin-bottom:3rem;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:4rem;}
  .proj-label{font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.2em;color:var(--red);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:0.75rem;}
  .proj-name{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(2.5rem,5vw,4.5rem);line-height:0.95;}
  .proj-blurb{flex:1;min-width:280px;font-size:0.9rem;color:rgba(245,242,235,0.7);line-height:1.9;}
  .proj-blurb p{margin-bottom:1rem;}

  .gallery-mosaic{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1rem;}
  .gallery-item{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--mid);cursor:pointer;}
  .gallery-item:first-child{grid-column:1/3;}
  .gallery-item:nth-child(4){grid-column:2/4;}
  .gallery-item img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;filter:brightness(0.85) saturate(0.9);transition:transform 0.5s,filter 0.5s;}
  .gallery-item:hover img{transform:scale(1.04);filter:brightness(1) saturate(1.1);}
  .gallery-cap{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;padding:1rem 1.25rem 0.75rem;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(10,10,10,0.85));font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.12em;color:var(--steel);text-transform:uppercase;opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px);transition:opacity 0.3s,transform 0.3s;}
  .gallery-item:hover .gallery-cap{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}

  .process-steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:2px;background:var(--border);margin-bottom:3rem;}
  .process-step{background:var(--black);padding:2.5rem 2rem;}
  .step-num{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:4rem;color:rgba(212,43,43,0.15);line-height:1;margin-bottom:1rem;}
  .step-title{font-weight:600;font-size:0.9rem;letter-spacing:0.05em;margin-bottom:0.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;}
  .step-desc{font-size:0.85rem;color:rgba(245,242,235,0.55);line-height:1.7;}

  .tech-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1rem;margin-bottom:3rem;}
  .tech-card{border:1px solid var(--border);padding:2rem;background:var(--mid);position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
  .tech-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:3px;height:100%;background:var(--red);}
  .tech-card-title{font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:0.65rem;letter-spacing:0.2em;color:var(--red);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:1rem;}
  .tech-card-value{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:2.5rem;line-height:1;margin-bottom:0.25rem;}
  .tech-card-desc{font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--steel);}

  .flight-table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;margin-bottom:3rem;}
  .flight-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:0.82rem;}
  .flight-table th{font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.15em;color:var(--red);text-transform:uppercase;text-align:left;padding:0.75rem 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--red);white-space:nowrap;}
  .flight-table td{padding:0.75rem 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);color:rgba(245,242,235,0.75);vertical-align:top;line-height:1.5;}
  .flight-table tr:hover td{background:var(--mid);color:var(--white);}
  .flight-num{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--red);}
  .flight-time{font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--white);}

  .badge-strip{display:flex;gap:1rem;margin-top:2rem;padding-top:2rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;}
  .badge{font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:0.7rem;color:var(--white);background:var(--mid);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:0.4rem 1rem;letter-spacing:0.1em;}
  .badge-label{font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.15em;color:var(--steel);text-transform:uppercase;align-self:center;}

  footer{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:3rem 2rem;max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;}
  .footer-name{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:1.5rem;letter-spacing:0.05em;}
  .footer-meta{font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:0.65rem;color:var(--steel);letter-spacing:0.1em;text-align:right;line-height:1.8;}

  .lightbox{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,10,10,0.95);z-index:1000;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:zoom-out;}
  .lightbox.active{display:flex;}
  .lightbox img{max-width:90vw;max-height:90vh;object-fit:contain;}

  .fade-in{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px);transition:opacity 0.7s ease,transform 0.7s ease;}
  .fade-in.visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}

  @media(max-width:768px){
    .tech-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .process-steps{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
    .gallery-mosaic{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .gallery-item:first-child,.gallery-item:nth-child(4){grid-column:1;}
    .hero-stats{gap:1.5rem;}
    .project-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .nav-links{display:none;}
    .proj-header{flex-direction:column;gap:2rem;}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="lightbox" id="lightbox" onclick="closeLightbox()">
  <img id="lightbox-img" src="" alt="">
</div>

<nav class="site-nav">
  <div class="site-nav-name">Tanisha Mani</div>
  <div class="nav-links">
    <a href="#ecar">E-Car Frame</a>
    <a href="#glider">Balsa Glider &amp; TSA</a>
  </div>
</nav>

<!-- HERO -->
<div class="hero">
  <div class="hero-top">
    <div class="hero-tag">Engineering Portfolio</div>
    <span style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:0.65rem;color:var(--steel);">West Forsyth High School</span>
  </div>
  <div class="hero-center">
    <h1 class="hero-title">TANISHA<br><span class="accent">MANI</span></h1>
    <p class="hero-sub">Engineering student at West Forsyth High School — designing electric race car chassis in SolidWorks and building rubber-powered balsa aircraft for TSA competition.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="hero-bottom">
    <div class="hero-stats">
      <div class="stat-item"><span class="stat-num">2</span><span class="stat-label">Projects</span></div>
      <div class="stat-item"><span class="stat-num">SW</span><span class="stat-label">SolidWorks</span></div>
      <div class="stat-item"><span class="stat-num">TSA</span><span class="stat-label">Competition</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="scroll-hint">↓ Scroll to explore</div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- PROJECT INDEX -->
<div class="proj-index fade-in">
  <div class="section-header">
    <span class="section-num">00</span>
    <h2 class="section-title">Projects</h2>
  </div>
  <div class="project-cards">
    <div class="project-card" onclick="document.getElementById('ecar').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})">
      <div class="project-card-num">01</div>
      <div class="project-card-title">E-Car Frame Design</div>
      <div class="project-card-desc">Aluminum C-frame chassis for a competition electric race car. Full 3D parametric model and production drawing in SolidWorks, developed from hand sketches through final dimensioned drawing.</div>
      <div class="project-card-tag">SolidWorks · CAD · Structural Design</div>
    </div>
    <div class="project-card" onclick="document.getElementById('glider').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})">
      <div class="project-card-num">02</div>
      <div class="project-card-title">Balsa Glider &amp; TSA Flight Endurance</div>
      <div class="project-card-desc">Designed in SolidWorks and physically built a rubber-powered balsa aircraft for the Washington TSA High School Flight Endurance Competition. Documented full aerodynamic build and flight trimming process across 10 flights.</div>
      <div class="project-card-tag">SolidWorks · Build · TSA · Aerodynamics</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══ PROJECT 01 — E-CAR ═══ -->
<div class="proj-section fade-in" id="ecar">
  <div class="proj-header">
    <div>
      <div class="proj-label">Project 01</div>
      <div class="proj-name">E-CAR<br>FRAME<br><span class="accent">DESIGN</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="proj-blurb">
      <p>Designed and modeled an aluminum C-frame chassis for a competition electric race car as part of West Forsyth High School's engineering program. The project spanned initial hand sketches through full SolidWorks 3D modeling and a production-intent engineering drawing.</p>
      <p>The chassis takes inspiration from Formula-style open-wheel packaging, with the driver reclined in a narrow envelope. Key priorities were structural rigidity through triangulated truss geometry, minimal weight, and driver safety — roll hoop, front and rear impact structures.</p>
      <p>The final drawing (Scale 1:8, Aluminum) was completed 9/20/24 and reflects the V2 revision of the frame.</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="gallery-mosaic" style="margin-bottom:3rem;">
    <div class="gallery-item" onclick="openLightbox(this)"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Competition cars on track"><div class="gallery-cap">Competition — Cars on Track</div></div>
    <div class="gallery-item" onclick="openLightbox(this)"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="SolidWorks 3D sketch"><div class="gallery-cap">SolidWorks — 3D Frame Sketch</div></div>
    <div class="gallery-item" onclick="openLightbox(this)"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Hand sketches v1"><div class="gallery-cap">Concept — Hand Sketches v1</div></div>
    <div class="gallery-item" onclick="openLightbox(this)"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="CAD engineering drawing"><div class="gallery-cap">CAD Drawing — C Frame V2</div></div>
    <div class="gallery-item" onclick="openLightbox(this)"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Formula EV reference"><div class="gallery-cap">Reference — Formula EV Architecture</div></div>
    <div class="gallery-item" onclick="openLightbox(this)"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Hand sketches v2"><div class="gallery-cap">Concept — Hand Sketches v2</div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="process-steps">
    <div class="process-step"><div class="step-num">01</div><div class="step-title">Research &amp; Reference</div><div class="step-desc">Studied Formula-style EV architecture — driver packaging, safety structures (roll hoop, halo, impact zones), and weight distribution.</div></div>
    <div class="process-step"><div class="step-num">02</div><div class="step-title">Concept Sketching</div><div class="step-desc">Developed orthographic views by hand — top, front, and side — exploring truss geometry and structural triangulation for the C-frame.</div></div>
    <div class="process-step"><div class="step-num">03</div><div class="step-title">3D CAD Modeling</div><div class="step-desc">Built a full parametric 3D sketch in SolidWorks, establishing the structural skeleton with precise node coordinates and member geometry.</div></div>
    <div class="process-step"><div class="step-num">04</div><div class="step-title">Production Drawing</div><div class="step-desc">Generated a formal engineering drawing (Scale 1:8) with full GD&T dimensioning across four views, ready for manufacturing review.</div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="tech-grid">
    <div class="tech-card"><div class="tech-card-title">Overall Length</div><div class="tech-card-value">72.00"</div><div class="tech-card-desc">Total chassis length nose to rear impact structure</div></div>
    <div class="tech-card"><div class="tech-card-title">Front Cockpit Width</div><div class="tech-card-value">18.50"</div><div class="tech-card-desc">Driver compartment width at widest point</div></div>
    <div class="tech-card"><div class="tech-card-title">Side Height</div><div class="tech-card-value">15–16"</div><div class="tech-card-desc">Frame height at main roll structure</div></div>
    <div class="tech-card"><div class="tech-card-title">Material</div><div class="tech-card-value">Aluminum</div><div class="tech-card-desc">C-frame constructed from aluminum extrusions for strength-to-weight ratio</div></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══ PROJECT 02 — BALSA GLIDER + TSA ═══ -->
<div class="proj-section fade-in" id="glider">
  <div class="proj-header">
    <div>
      <div class="proj-label">Project 02</div>
      <div class="proj-name">BALSA GLIDER<br>&amp; TSA<br><span class="accent">FLIGHT</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="proj-blurb">
      <p>Designed and modeled a rubber-powered balsa wood glider in SolidWorks, then physically built and flew it at the Washington Technology Student Association High School Flight Endurance Competition (SeaTac, WA — March 2021).</p>
      <p>The SolidWorks model captures the full structural skeleton — main wing with rib-and-spar construction, horizontal stabilizer, vertical fins, fuselage boom, propeller assembly, and wire landing gear. The physical build followed TSA specifications with carbon fiber spars, balsa ribs, and a mylar skin.</p>
      <p>Flight trimming was conducted across 10 test flights, systematically adjusting rubber width, wind count, torque, propeller pitch, and wing incidence to maximize time aloft.</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- SolidWorks renders only -->
  <div style="margin-bottom:1rem;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.2em;color:var(--red);text-transform:uppercase;">SolidWorks Model</div>
  <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:auto auto;gap:1rem;margin-bottom:3rem;">
    <div class="gallery-item" style="grid-row:1/3;" onclick="openLightbox(this)">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Isometric view — full assembly">
      <div class="gallery-cap">Isometric View — Full Assembly</div>
    </div>
    <div class="gallery-item" onclick="openLightbox(this)">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Side and front views">
      <div class="gallery-cap">Side &amp; Front Views</div>
    </div>
    <div class="gallery-item" onclick="openLightbox(this)">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Top-down planform view">
      <div class="gallery-cap">Top-Down Planform View</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Aircraft specs -->
  <div class="tech-grid">
    <div class="tech-card"><div class="tech-card-title">Max Wingspan</div><div class="tech-card-value">45 cm</div><div class="tech-card-desc">Carbon fiber spars, balsa airfoil ribs, mylar skin with winglets</div></div>
    <div class="tech-card"><div class="tech-card-title">Rubber Motor</div><div class="tech-card-value">1.5 g max</div><div class="tech-card-desc">Tan supersport rubber; up to 1,800 winds at 36–50 g·cm torque</div></div>
    <div class="tech-card"><div class="tech-card-title">Propeller</div><div class="tech-card-value">17 cm</div><div class="tech-card-desc">Elliptical Ikara prop trimmed to TSA spec, 3° left thrust offset</div></div>
    <div class="tech-card"><div class="tech-card-title">Fuselage</div><div class="tech-card-value">0.8 mm CF</div><div class="tech-card-desc">Carbon fiber rod motor stick, tail boom offset 9.525 mm for left-turning flight</div></div>
  </div>

  <!-- Flight log -->
  <div style="margin-bottom:1rem;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:0.6rem;letter-spacing:0.2em;color:var(--red);text-transform:uppercase;">TSA Flight Log — 10 Trimming Flights</div>
  <p style="font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--steel);margin-bottom:1.5rem;line-height:1.7;">Systematically adjusted rubber configuration and airframe trim across each flight to maximize time aloft.</p>
  <div class="flight-table-wrap">
    <table class="flight-table">
      <thead>
        <tr><th>#</th><th>Time Aloft</th><th>Rubber Width</th><th>Winds</th><th>Torque</th><th>Flight Pattern</th><th>Adjustment Made</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td><span class="flight-num">1</span></td><td><span class="flight-time">0:38</span></td><td>2.3876 mm</td><td>300</td><td>28.8 g·cm</td><td>Slow climb, nose down descent</td><td>Increased wing incidence</td></tr>
        <tr><td><span class="flight-num">2</span></td><td><span class="flight-time">1:01</span></td><td>2.3876 mm</td><td>600</td><td>36 g·cm</td><td>Nose up climb, level descent</td><td>Increased rubber turns</td></tr>
        <tr><td><span class="flight-num">3</span></td><td><span class="flight-time">1:57</span></td><td>2.3876 mm</td><td>1200</td><td>50.4 g·cm</td><td>Nose up climb, level descent</td><td>No trim needed</td></tr>
        <tr><td><span class="flight-num">4</span></td><td><span class="flight-time">1:39</span></td><td>2.2606 mm</td><td>1250</td><td>50.4 g·cm</td><td>Fast climb</td><td>Repitched propeller</td></tr>
        <tr><td><span class="flight-num">5</span></td><td><span class="flight-time">1:19</span></td><td>2.2606 mm</td><td>1250</td><td>50.4 g·cm</td><td>Fast climb, unstable due to breeze</td><td>Reduced breeze, decreased torque &amp; width</td></tr>
        <tr><td><span class="flight-num">6</span></td><td><span class="flight-time">2:02</span></td><td>2.0066 mm</td><td>1250</td><td>43.2 g·cm</td><td>Steady climb, turns remaining on motor</td><td>Switched to smaller O-rings</td></tr>
        <tr><td><span class="flight-num">7</span></td><td><span class="flight-time">2:30</span></td><td>2.0066 mm</td><td>1500</td><td>43.2 g·cm</td><td>Fast steady climb, stall at ceiling</td><td>Decreased torque, increased turns</td></tr>
        <tr><td><span class="flight-num">8</span></td><td><span class="flight-time">2:28</span></td><td>2.0066 mm</td><td>1800</td><td>28.8 g·cm</td><td>Slow climb, insufficient altitude</td><td>Increased rubber torque</td></tr>
        <tr><td><span class="flight-num">9</span></td><td><span class="flight-time">2:31</span></td><td>2.0066 mm</td><td>1800</td><td>43.2 g·cm</td><td>Fast climb, stall at ceiling</td><td>Decreased rubber torque</td></tr>
        <tr><td><span class="flight-num">10</span></td><td><span class="flight-time">2:37</span></td><td>2.0066 mm</td><td>1800</td><td>36 g·cm</td><td>Slow climb, steady glide, no ceiling hits</td><td>Increased rubber turns</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div class="badge-strip">
    <span class="badge-label">Tools &amp; Skills:</span>
    <span class="badge">SolidWorks</span>
    <span class="badge">Aerodynamics</span>
    <span class="badge">Balsa Construction</span>
    <span class="badge">Carbon Fiber</span>
    <span class="badge">Flight Trimming</span>
    <span class="badge">TSA Competition</span>
  </div>
</div>

<footer class="fade-in">
  <div>
    <div class="footer-name">Tanisha Mani</div>
    <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:0.65rem;color:var(--steel);margin-top:0.25rem;">West Forsyth High School — Engineering</div>
  </div>
  <div class="footer-meta">
    Engineering Portfolio · 2021–2026<br>
    SolidWorks · TSA · E-Car Frame
  </div>
</footer>

<script>
  const faders = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in');
  const obs = new IntersectionObserver(e => e.forEach(x => { if(x.isIntersecting) x.target.classList.add('visible'); }),{threshold:0.08});
  faders.forEach(f => obs.observe(f));
  function openLightbox(el){
    const img = el.tagName==='IMG'?el:el.querySelector('img');
    document.getElementById('lightbox-img').src=img.src;
    document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.add('active');
  }
  function closeLightbox(){document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.remove('active');}
  document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeLightbox();});
</script>
</body>
</html>
